entities.summary: Lawrence Alexander Sidney Johnson known as Lawrie Johnson, was an Australian taxonomic botanist. He worked at the Royal Botanic Gardens, Sydney, for the whole of his professional career, as a botanist (1948–1972), Director (1972–1985) and Honorary Research Associate (1986–1997). The standard author abbreviation L.A.S.Johnson is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
